policy: Exact path equality: no new violation and no stale allow-list entry.

domain-dependencies.reason: Existing Domain files that still reference an outer/application concern; exact paths only.

application-dependencies.reason: Existing standardized Application files that still reference infrastructure/provider/document concerns.

contracts-concrete-types.reason: Existing Contracts files that still mention concrete services, repositories, documents or providers.

endpoint-persistence.reason: Existing endpoint hosts that still contain repository/document composition or access.

cross-module-project-references.reason: Direct module-to-module project references present at the Stage 1 snapshot.

building-blocks-module-types.reason: Module-specific WorkItems, Identity, Projects or permission types still owned by BuildingBlocks.

domain-documents.reason: Persistence documents physically located under module Domain.

module-http-types.reason: ASP.NET/HTTP types still present in standardized module Domain or Application paths.

partial-part-limit.reason: Exact fragment files belonging to partial owners above eight parts.

method-partial-files.reason: Exact method-like partial fragment paths in the Stage 1 snapshot.

namespace-directory.reason: Baseline CLR type identities retained during staged namespace migration; exact compatibility paths only. See NAMESPACE_COMPATIBILITY_PLAN.md.

path-length.reason: Exact repository-relative production paths above the 200-character portability budget.
